backend_rule: Provider and language-specific code ends at normalized events; the frontend consumes only this contract.

analytics.description: Windowed activity, participant attribution, and logical timestamp observations.
analytics.label: Observation analytics
analytics.reason: Read-only analytics over retained normalized observations.

attributes.description: Decoded or opaque attribute update observations.
attributes.label: Attribute values

commands.description: Explicitly registered adapter actions and correlated execution history.
commands.label: Session commands
commands.reason: No command dispatcher is configured; this backend is read-only.

event_history.description: Bounded, sequence-numbered event retention and cursor pages.
event_history.label: Event history
event_history.reason: Provided by the provider-neutral observer store.

federates.description: Participant join, update, and resignation observations.
federates.label: Federate roster

http_api.description: HTTP resources for contract, state, metrics, and event pages.
http_api.label: HTTP API

lifecycle.description: Connection, startup, shutdown, and runtime errors.
lifecycle.label: Runtime lifecycle

live_inspectors.description: Derived object, interaction, and federate views.
live_inspectors.label: Live inspectors
live_inspectors.reason: Derived from normalized events without requiring provider APIs.

logical_time.description: Time regulation, constraints, grants, and timestamped delivery.
logical_time.label: Logical time

metrics.description: Event counts, rates, retention, and adapter health metrics.
metrics.label: Observer metrics
metrics.reason: Provided by the provider-neutral observer store.

mom.label: Management object model
mom.reason: This profile represents an RTI without MOM callbacks.

object_observations.description: Persistent attributed object snapshots and retained attribute comparisons.
object_observations.label: Object perspectives
object_observations.reason: Built from explicit event attribution; no MOM or provider queries required.

objects.description: Object discovery, removal, and attribute updates.
objects.label: Object observations

ownership.description: Ownership acquisition, divestiture, and query observations.
ownership.label: Attribute ownership
ownership.reason: This profile does not expose ownership callbacks.

persistence.description: Federation save, restore, and related lifecycle observations.
persistence.label: Save and restore
persistence.reason: Save and restore observation is disabled for this profile.

regions.description: Region creation and region-scoped publication or subscription.
regions.label: Regions and DDM
regions.reason: This profile does not expose region callbacks.

sse.description: Live event delivery over an HTTP event stream.
sse.label: Server-sent events

time_inspection.description: Last reported grants/state and bounded explicitly correlated requests, without MOM.
time_inspection.label: Persistent time inspection
time_inspection.reason: Grants only; request IDs and time-role state are not reported.

websocket.description: Live event delivery over a WebSocket connection.
websocket.label: WebSocket stream

state_meanings.available: The feature is supported and enabled for observation.
state_meanings.disabled: The feature is supported or configured but turned off.
state_meanings.partial: Only some of the feature surface is available.
state_meanings.unknown: The provider or backend did not advertise its support.
state_meanings.unsupported: The connected provider or backend cannot provide it.

event_envelope.extension_rule: Unknown fields are retained and must remain JSON-compatible.
